review.summary: Fix for missing method dispatches for CartesianIndex arguments in need_batch_index and splitcs functions. Before this fix, indexing a DiskArray with a CartesianIndex would fail because the dispatch path had no method handling CartesianIndex (only CartesianIndices was handled). The commit adds the missing methods and a corresponding test.
review.evidence: The commit title explicitly states 'Fix need_batch for cartesianindex arguments (#166)'. The patch adds two new method signatures: `need_batch_index(i::CartesianIndex{N}, ...)` and `splitcs(i::CartesianIndex, cs)` which mirror existing methods for `CartesianIndices` but handle the singular `CartesianIndex` case. The test adds `a[CartesianIndex(1,1,1)] = -10` which would have errored (MethodError) before the fix, confirming existing behavior was violated.

review.suggested_tests: 1. Test `a[CartesianIndex(1,1,1)]` read access (getindex) in addition to setindex. 2. Test with CartesianIndex of different dimensionalities (e.g., 2D). 3. Verify that mixed indexing like `a[CartesianIndex(1,1), 1]` still works correctly.
